checked_claims.claim: Parameter flows from callspec to SubRequest unchanged
Cache compares equality before identity fallback
checked_claims.reason: Different equal dictionaries can produce cache hits.

material_errors: False claim different dictionary instances cannot cache correctly because comparisons use identity.
tasks.notes: Read the question/reference and relevant pinned-source code; static review only, no repository code executed.
tasks.corrected_reference_answer: Indirect parameters are retrieved directly from callspec.params and passed into SubRequest (src/_pytest/fixtures.py:614-637). FixtureDef.cache_key returns request.param (lines1136-1137), but this value is compared rather than hashed: execute first tries bool(request_cache_key == cache_key), falling back to identity only when equality raises ValueError or RuntimeError (lines1093-1113). Consequently non-hashable dictionaries need no transformation, and distinct equal dictionaries can hit the cache. Mutating shared parameters can change comparison behavior; no immutable copy is promised.

checked_claims.claim: Completer sorts combined glob results then slices output paths
checked_claims.reason: No deduplication operation; wildcard input bypasses automatic appending and hidden expansion.

material_errors: Claims deduplicated result and omits precise post-sort prefix-strip consequence.
tasks.notes: Read the question/reference and relevant pinned-source code; static review only, no repository code executed.
tasks.corrected_reference_answer: FastFilesCompleter computes a prefix_dir length, then for prefixes without * or ? adds hidden matches only for an empty prefix or trailing separator and appends * for ordinary matches. Existing wildcard prefixes are globbed directly (src/_pytest/_argcomplete.py:80-93). It sorts full matches, adds / to directories, and strips prefix_dir characters from each emitted completion (lines94-99). Output order therefore follows pre-stripping full paths, rather than a fresh sort of displayed names. There is no explicit deduplication.

checked_claims.reason: Snapshot reads/seeks/truncates in separate operations; no locks or transaction.

checked_claims.claim: State methods switch sys stream bindings

tasks.notes: Read the question/reference and relevant pinned-source code; static review only, no repository code executed.
tasks.corrected_reference_answer: SysCapture.snap reads tmpfile then seeks and truncates it; writeorg writes and flushes the saved original stream. Both require started or suspended state (src/_pytest/capture.py:450-461). start/resume bind the system stream to tmpfile while suspend restores the original (lines402-426). This separates sequential snapshotting from bypass output, but the operations are not an atomic transaction and these methods provide no locking guarantee for concurrent writes.

tasks.notes: Read the question/reference and relevant pinned-source code; static review only, no repository code executed.
tasks.corrected_reference_answer: TestReport.from_item_and_call marks no-exception calls passed, non-ExceptionInfo failures failed with their raw representation, skips skipped with item/crash location, and other exceptions failed (src/_pytest/reports.py:349-375). For call-phase failures it delegates to item.repr_failure; setup/teardown use item._repr_failure_py with configured tbstyle (lines376-381). Delegation permits item-specific formatting; it does not mean call failures ignore tbstyle—Python Function.repr_failure explicitly reads that option (src/_pytest/python.py:1706-1713).

tasks.notes: Read the question/reference and relevant pinned-source code; static review only, no repository code executed.
tasks.corrected_reference_answer: TestRequestScopeAccess parametrizes scope/allowed/error attributes, uses the pytester fixture to write generated tests with autouse or explicit fixtures, and runs them via inline_run (testing/python/fixtures.py:3430-3479). The generated fixtures inspect request properties. FixtureRequest’s property guards provide the actual attribute restriction: function only at function scope, cls at class/function, module at module/class/function, and path additionally at package scope (src/_pytest/fixtures.py:451-489). SubRequest._check_scope instead rejects invalid fixture dependency scopes; it is a separate check (lines780-801).
